newer_changes_search: Web search for 2025-2026 changes: reports of an Aug 2026 PIB release on PM-SYM (revival window for dormant accounts extended to three years, two-way integration with e-Shram, registration drives). No change to eligibility (18-40, income up to ₹15,000, not in EPF/ESIC/NPS, not a taxpayer) or the ₹3,000 pension found.

findings.note: Family pension after death at 60+ is correct; the spouse's option to continue if the worker dies before 60 is not mentioned.
findings.suggestion: Optional: add the before-60 option from the source.

findings.note: The 'unorganised sector worker' condition is not encoded; it is largely covered by the EPF/ESIC/NPS exclusion. income_max uses the right field and boundary (₹15,000 or less).
